author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam welcomes back to the cave Riley Kolbow (aka @worksbydesign ) to check out his latest project: a nearly unpickable mechanical lock! We learn about Riley's iterative process designing this lock, the ways in which locks are most commonly picked, and the key that makes Riley's lock a challenge for lockpickers. 

Works by Design's pickproof lock: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-qUu8kIliy8 and find more of Riley's videos at @worksbydesign 

Shot and edited by Josh Self
